title: Universal rank-matched direct-image and canonical base-change condition
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal E$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $g:T\to S$. Use tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], direct image and its adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Write $p_g:X_T\to T$, $q_g:X_T\to X$, $N_g=p_{g,*}q_g^*\mathcal E$, and $D_g=p_{g,*}q_g^*(\mathcal E^\vee)$, where the dual is internal Hom into $\mathcal O_X$. The condition $P(f,\mathcal E,g)$ means: (1) $N_g$ is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]; (2) for every $h:T\prime\to T$ and every point $t$ of $T\prime$, there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $t$ and a natural number $r$ such that $N_{h\circ g}|_U$, $D_{h\circ g}|_U$, and the pullback of $\mathcal E$ to $X_U$ are all finite locally free of constant rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]; (3) for every such $h$, both canonical ordinary module base-change maps [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction] for $p_g$ and $q_g^*\mathcal E$, respectively $q_g^*(\mathcal E^\vee)$, are isomorphisms. In (3) the square is the categorical pullback of $p_g$ along $h$; the target is the pushforward of the further tensor pullback.
